summary: On paper this one is close: Carolina's best edge is to throw early (Carolina ranks 1st in early-down EPA per dropback, +0.24), while Green Bay's best counter is to finish drives (Green Bay ranks 30th in red-zone TD rate, 59%). Under center, Jordan Love ranks 9th of 30 in EPA per dropback and Bryce Young ranks 10th; x-factor: Matthew Golden gets 27% of Green Bay's targets and 38% of its air yards, and Carolina's pass defense ranks 19th. The model favors Carolina at 51%, mostly on rushing matchup (3.2 pts) and offensive injuries (0.7 pts).
